messages:
rebecca (recruiter): heads-up  during panel prep noticed interviewers getting the wrong scorecard template version (old questions) in the UI. happened on two concurrent interviews. :confused:

maria (people-ops): did this happen after the form rollout last night? any panel ids or candidates?

rebecca (recruiter): rollout id `evalform-rollout-2026-09-03`  panels P-10022, P-10023; candidates C-8100, C-8101. interviewers opened the form and saw v1 instead of v2.

oliver (trainer): thanks. symptoms sound like a caching or template-resolver fallback. v2 should be the default for those roles. can someone paste the form-service event?

anil (eng): form-service log snippet: "deploy evalform-v2 at 2026-09-03T02:05Z, publish_flag=true" then later "resolver returned template v1 for role eng-interviewer when cache-miss hit fallback stack". suspect mismatch between publish registry and resolver TTL.

qa-bot: automated event: evalform-rollout-2026-09-03 deployed at 2026-09-03T02:05:12Z, publisher=forms-service, rollout=canary->prod

maria (people-ops): blocking? we have 2 panels in next 90m. can we force-expire the resolver cache or reissue links to guarantee v2?

anil (eng): i can invalidate the resolver cache for roles affected and re-run template reconciliation for P-10022,P-10023. will run now and report in ~6m. pref mitigation: don't rollback, just invalidate caches.

oliver (trainer): also please reissue scorecard links for those panel members. i'll confirm with interviewers after cache flush.

anil (eng): cache invalidate done. reconciler job started: `reconcile-templates-2801234575` targeted panels P-10022,P-10023.

qa-bot: job reconcile-templates-2801234575 started at 2026-09-03T02:40:00Z, targets=2

anil (eng): reconciler finished  templates now resolve to v2 for both panels. reissued links for interviewers. PR opened to add a cache-bust hook to rollout pipeline: https://github.com/redwood/forms/pull/612 (wip).

rebecca (recruiter): confirmed with interviewers  they now see v2 and questions are up-to-date. thanks. small ask: can People Ops get a rollback/playbook for future rollouts so hiring managers know what to expect?

maria (people-ops): yes. i'll add a line to the rollout checklist: "invalidate form resolver cache and reconcile templates before enabling scheduling." scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow with forms team to add runbook and alerting.

oliver (trainer): adding a note to interviewer onboarding: "if scorecard questions look wrong, DM People Ops and do not proceed with the panel until confirmed."

anil (eng): adding guard in rollout pipeline to run reconciliation post-deploy. also instrumenting an alert when >0 panels are served v1 after v2 publish. will follow-up in the PR.

maria (people-ops): filing REC-6319 and assigning owners. thanks everyone for quick fix. :thumbsup:
